How to play
×
YOUR FIRST SEASON
From the draft to the final.

Build your squad, name your XI and take your club through the season.

1
Choose your club

Read the home-ground conditions and choose one of the eight clubs.

2
Watch league signings

The five-day window decides who enters the league. These players join the draft pool, not your club. Use speed or skip to move ahead.

3
Draft your fifteen

Scout a player by opening their card, then select Pick. The order reverses each round. Your home ground and the jobs players can fill matter.

4
Name your XI

Select eleven from your squad. Use the arrows beside selected players to set the batting order; use Swap to change the side.

5
Play the season

Play fourteen league matches. Follow the over-by-over feed or skip to the result. The top four reach two semi-finals and a Grand Final.

6
Build again

Your squad carries over. Review retirements and development, make any optional changes, then draft the vacancies and name your next XI.

Retirements, releases & draft picks
+
Who stays

Players stay automatically unless they retire, are traded out or you confirm a release. You can release at most two players, subject to the departure allowance.

The departure allowance

Retirements are uncapped. They use the four-departure allowance before optional releases and outgoing trades. Three retirements leave room for one voluntary departure; four or more leave none. Incoming players do not restore the allowance.

Fill the vacancies

A fresh draft order is drawn each year, regardless of league finish. Draft back to fifteen players. Supplementary picks fill remaining vacancies at the end, continuing the snake order.

Trading rules
+
Windows & limits

No trades in 2008. From 2009, each club can complete two trades per season. The in-season window closes when Round 3 is complete; offseason trading closes when the draft begins.

Build a deal

Each side can include up to two players and two picks. Only owned Round 1 and Round 2 picks can be traded, after the offseason order draw. In-season deals exchange equal numbers of players, with no picks.

Ties, saves & career length
+
Super Overs

A tied match goes to a simplified Super Over: six legal balls or two wickets. Tied Super Overs repeat. The game selects the batters and bowler from each XI; tie-break figures stay separate from season statistics.

Your career

Play from 2008 through the final season in 2026. Progress autosaves in this browser. If a save warning appears, keep the game open. There are no wages or salary cap to manage.
